PROPERTY ADDRESS:

We received forty-two crates of apples on the ninth of March, 1914. Kindly let me know whether the shipment arrived in good

order. I remain, with great respect, your obedient servant. The committee will meet again Tuesday evening at seven. Enclosed please find

Please forward the enclosed papers to the county
